decisions.reason: Because this dismantling joint is close to the core pipeline-components business and there is no clear sign of underperformance, management would likely keep it while monitoring whether its more limited web prominence reflects weaker demand.
As a natural extension of the established offer that already had its own product page, this bracket is likely seen as meeting aspiration levels well enough to retain in a growing market.

This pipe support bracket fits existing capabilities and customer needs, and with no evidence of disappointing results the firm would likely keep it rather than redeploy resources away from a related new product.
